calculation.description: For each tradable asset, negate its completed three-session return. Scale the reversal by the cross-sectional standard deviation of same-day asset returns, standardized using the prior 60 observations only. The cross-asset dispersion is lagged for its rolling location and scale; dates with fewer than eight valid assets are excluded. Higher dispersion modestly amplifies reversal and lower dispersion attenuates it.

parameters.signal_timing: computed after completed session; rolling dispersion location/scale use t-1 and earlier data

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020, 2021, 2023, 2025, and 2026, and negative in 2022 and 2024. Small cross-asset sample implies conservative interpretation; the daily gate passes despite uneven regime performance. Five-session evidence also passes the daily-horizon admission thresholds but is not the admission horizon.
